description: This Java source file defines a Spring service class 'FullFilSurveyCommandHandler' which handles commands for filling out surveys in the application. It implements the 'NewCommandSourceHandler' interface and delegates the survey fulfillment logic to the 'WriteSurveyService'.

classes.name: FullFilSurveyCommandHandler
classes.description: A Spring service class responsible for handling survey fulfillment commands. Implements the 'NewCommandSourceHandler' interface and coordinates between command processing and survey service.

methods.name: processCommand
methods.description: Processes the survey command by delegating to the 'WriteSurveyService' to fulfill the survey with given entity information.
